name: Digital Nomad Visa / Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires net monthly income of at least EUR 3,500, increased by 20% for a spouse/cohabitant and 15% per child, earned from remote work for employers or clients located outside Greece.
requirements.fix_path: Document qualifying remote income before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: Work must be performed remotely using information and communication technologies for employers or clients based outside Greece -- local employment is not permitted under this visa.

evidence_required.document: Proof of remote employment/client contracts outside Greece

outcome.duration_length: initial visa up to 12 months; residence permit option for 2 years, renewable

sources.title: EY Greece tax alert -- Digital Nomad Visa (Law 4825/2021, Government Gazette A' 157/4.9.2021): EUR 3,500/month net income, +20% spouse, +15%/child

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Greece's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: EY (a Big Four professional services firm) cites the exact law and Government Gazette number, and the EUR 3,500 figure is corroborated across many independent tier-3/4 sources -- but the law's own text (Law 4825/2021) and migration.gov.gr's own digital-nomad pages were not directly located and fetched at tier-1 in this pass, so the figure is not independently confirmed at government level. family_can_work set false: EY's summary states family members get visas of matching validity but explicitly do not gain employment rights.
